summary: Lookout tower in Yancey County, NC. Forest Lookouts gives a 1943 state-built tower (45-foot 9-inch); a 2008 Toe River blog post lists a Phillips Knob tower erected in 1961. No source read says whether these are one structure. The 2008 account says standing, not publicly accessible.

facts.status_note: Standing in a 2008 account that relays Peter J. Barr's book; no later source read.

notes_for_editor: Two build dates conflict and this story does not resolve them. 1943: Forest Lookouts index (state-erected 45-foot 9-inch tower, citing the 10th Biennial Report, 1944). 1961: Toe River History blog, 2008, which relays Peter J. Barr's book (not read directly). Both may describe one structure or two towers; no source read says which, and the story says only that the dates disagree. 'Still standing, not publicly accessible' rests only on the 2008 blog; no later source read. Height 13.9 m is converted from the 1943 entry's 45-foot 9-inch figure (assumed to be tower height). The tnlandforms registers code FB 3915 is not used. Brief record had no errors. Search budget ran out, so search leads were not checked; a direct read of Barr's book or NC Forest Service records would be the next checks. Fact-check 2026-10-21: removed the unsupported 'state's list' wording; the blog's 1961 tower is no longer presented as the same tower as the 1943 entry; added evidence quotes for the Phillips Knob pairing, Barr's authorship and the 2008 post date.
